dct_title_s: Damage assessment in City of Naga Municipality, Cebu Province, Region VII, Philippines as of 21 December 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20211216PHL** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures and buildings in City of Naga & Minglanilla municipalities, Cebu province, Region VII (Central Visayas), Philippines as observed from a Pleiades image acquired on 21 December 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT identified 876 damaged structures and 1,361 potentially damaged structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT.
